content.title: JBG Smith acquires Tysons Dulles Plaza office campus
content.summary: JBG Smith (JBGS) announced its acquisition of Tysons Dulles Plaza, a 15-acre office campus in Tysons, Virginia. The three-building campus encompasses approximately 500,000 square feet of offices and 1,553 parking spaces. JBG Smith intends to re-entitle and redevelop one office building for residential use, while enhancing and modernizing the other two for office tenants.
